evidence_basis.finding: A newly committed self-hosted replay workflow was still bound to an older work revision after newer owner-fixed/observability revisions existed. This is a control/provenance counterexample: successful execution on stale work semantics must not receive current-work completion or promotion credit.

preserve_current_frontier.next_semantic_work: Disposition every residual class as LOWERED_AND_VALIDATED, EXPLICITLY_DEFERRED_FAIL_CLOSED, or REJECTED_WITH_REASON; rule_decl and invariant_decl first; then prove downstream evaluator/lowering consumption and fail-closed behavior.

mandatory_pre_effect_revision_binding: Immediately before every material WP04/WP05 execution, resolve the latest relevant WORK_CREATE/WORK_REVISE event for the work_id and re-read current repo head.
Bind each execution receipt to work_id, latest work event_id/spec revision when present, repo head, execution-start timestamp, and the exact component/content hashes used by that test.

If a newer relevant work revision exists before effect, or the receipt reports an older revision than the latest pre-effect revision, classify the result STALE_EXECUTION_RECEIPT. Preserve it as diagnostic/negative evidence but grant no CC-WP-03, BASE, canonical-promotion, or current-work completion credit.
If a relevant work revision changes the test obligation or any bound component changes, invalidate inherited receipts and rerun only the affected discriminator on current bytes/specification.
Do not rerun the already-clean WP03 bridge merely for ceremony; rerun it only if one of its bound components or controlling acceptance obligations changes.
